allocation_impact: Validate UTF-8 byte length from borrowed/already-bounded source before any retained String copy; checked aggregate configuration arithmetic and same-root I reservation must succeed before allocation.
boundary_tests: 63 UTF-8 bytes accepted when the role name is otherwise valid and all coupled retained-config checks pass
64 UTF-8 bytes rejected as UNAVAILABLE before retained allocation or authentication setup
No silent PostgreSQL identifier truncation is accepted
notes: First-slice product cap matches PostgreSQL 17's default max_identifier_length of 63 bytes for identifiers. A server recompiled for a larger NAMEDATALEN does not widen this Oteryn profile.
